scope: Opaque CANN SDK artifact retention and native observation failure recovery; five owned Python source/test files only.

environment.execution: CPU-only inside existing flagprism-enflame-dev Docker on zhiyuan_suiyuan

test_entry.requires: Current source with matching built runtime; run in Docker, no GPU session or SDK activation.

format.new_files: Full-file YAPF; AST equivalence and idempotence checked.
format.existing_files: Changed ranges relative to c207f6e5f2c511ef5c20f6a25e67a4c106f077c5; AST equivalence and changed-range idempotence checked.
format.ruff: Passed on cann_artifacts.py, profile.py and hooks/instrumentation.py.

recovery_oracles.oracle: Unknown explicit session ID exits before metadata parsing or state/native effects.
Repeated finalize preserves output and another active session.
Peek is non-destructive; ack removes only selected capture IDs/session membership; legacy take remains usable.
Acknowledgement follows durable atomic publication and directory sync; another session remains queued.
Corrupt old JSON remains unchanged; raw bytes recover from a journal in a new process.
Allocation/replace failures preserve old sidecar and recoverable raw.
Fallback journal remains independently readable after state drop and staging removal.
All storage failures explicitly report not durable and preserve unacknowledged in-process captures.
Retry merges only identical full payloads, avoids duplicate observations, and cleans owned journal after success.
A post-replace sync failure can retry without duplicating the capture.
Conflicting payload for the same ID fails with original sidecar, queue and journal retained.
Serialization failure explicitly reports not durable and does not acknowledge raw.
Real truncated Proton CPU decoder preserves original exception identity and raw SHA; export yields no execution events.
Native finalize, launch snapshot or task producer failure still durably saves completed host raw and preserves original cause without claiming a full bundle.

limitations: All storage locations failing leaves captures unacknowledged in process memory and reports explicitly not durable.
Malformed native packets preserve raw bytes and decoder error without fabricated observations.
CPU lifecycle tests and a real CPU decoder establish neither GPU execution nor actual SDK/native backend support.

historical_negative.reason: Test incorrectly required events.jsonl for an empty bundle; corrected assertion checks empty report events/untimed and absent or empty event file. Final real decoder case passes.

content_audit.allowed_content: Small JSON summaries and UTF-8 test/tool logs only.
content_audit.excluded: No SDK headers or libraries, databases, PDF/copyright paper content, device raw buffers, credentials or large raw archives.
content_audit.private_key_and_access_key_pattern_scan: No matches; selected files manually reviewed.

historical_negative_verbatim_archive.reason: Preserve original pytest bytes, including whitespace, without modifying the raw historical log.
